items.q: How does the AI background remover work without uploading my photos?
items.a: Our tool uses a state-of-the-art AI model (RMBG-1.4/MODNet) that runs entirely inside your web browser using WebAssembly. When you select an image, the model is downloaded once to your browser's memory and processes the pixels locally. No data ever leaves your device.

items.q: Is this background remover really free?
items.a: Yes, it is 100% free with no usage limits, no watermarks, and no registration required. We believe high-quality privacy-first tools should be accessible to everyone.

items.q: What image formats are supported for background removal?
items.a: We support most common image formats including PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP, and HEIC. The output is always a transparent PNG to preserve the removed background.

items.q: Can I remove backgrounds from high-resolution images?
items.a: Absolutely. Unlike many online tools that downscale your images, SafeTools processes your images at their original resolution (depending on your device's RAM) to ensure professional-grade results.
Yes. Since the processing happens on your local machine, we never see your photos. Even if you disconnect your internet after the initial model load, the tool will still work perfectly.

items.q: Does it work on mobile devices?
items.a: Yes, it works on modern mobile browsers. However, since the AI model requires some processing power and RAM, it performs best on devices with at least 4GB of memory.
